title: Nat Story, trombonist with Fate Marable
summary: Nat Story played with Marable in the early years on the boats and now teaches trombone in Kentucky.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: What about Nat's story? Do you remember him?
Yes, he's, uh, he was a trombone player. And a good one, and he's now in Purdue, Kentucky, and he's, uh, teaching trombone in one of the schools. Nathaniel Storyans.
And who did he play with?
He'd been on the boats, but I didn't know when.
That'd be early or late years?

Early, early years. He, uh, well, he'd be, I forget the guess of what years it would happen, but, uh, he would, Peyton Marlowe, and there's a whole length of time we were in the honors for 20, 25 years, and so, these are fellas coming different times, but, uh, he was one, uh, he was there for three or four years. He always wanted to put a band on the boat, but we never just let him put one on, but, uh, he was a good man. He was a trombone player.
